作为AI建筑分析师，请仅关注上传平面图中的儿童房区域。生成一段简洁的英文段落，描述其布局、拟配置的家具、软装饰以及照明。描述应是对空间及其内容的事实性、客观性清单，准确反映图中所示的尺寸和位置。请勿使用任何风格化或装饰性语言。输出内容必须仅为描述本身，不包含任何引导语或房间标签。

"Generate a high-quality, photorealistic image of a cozy and inviting bedroom that blends modern and traditional design elements. The room features a king-sized bed with a plush upholstered headboard in a rich, deep blue color, complemented by soft white linens and decorative pillows in various textures. On either side of the bed, there are matching nightstands made of dark walnut wood, each topped with a vintage-style table lamp with a cream-colored shade, providing warm, ambient lighting. 

A large, ornate mirror hangs above a mid-century modern dresser on one wall, reflecting the light from the adjacent window which is dressed with elegant, floor-length curtains in a subtle floral pattern. The flooring is hardwood, stained in a medium oak finish, which adds a natural warmth to the space. A thick, luxurious area rug in shades of gray and blue anchors the center of the room, creating a sense of comfort underfoot.

The walls are painted a soft, calming gray, with one accent wall featuring a delicate wallpaper with a geometric pattern. There is also a comfortable reading nook by the window, complete with a single armchair and a small side table, perfect for enjoying a quiet moment with a book. The overall color palette is soothing, with touches of gold and green from potted plants, contributing to a peaceful and serene environment."
